title: Let's Build the Industrial Smart-Crafter
description:
We finally have a universal autocrafter capable of handling mixed items and scheduled recipe's. Granted the system can only store the first 7 recipe's as dependent on items from previous recipe's, but this is a significant improvement over the previous design.

Try out the world download and let me know what you think about autocrafters:
http://www.mediafire.com/file/ckqql0ubh1g2k52/Let%2527s_Build_-_Autocrafter.zip/file
